patent_grounding.rationale: Revision 6's added single controller-to-remote_actuator connection matches the patent's express statement that remotely controlled actuating mechanism 116 is connected to controller 32 via signal line 118 (710847db3a194a2881ac80cc4b186a68). Its command port and flow connect the stated endpoints without asserting a command encoding or control law.

functional_completeness.rationale: The formerly missing command link now closes the supported path: controller command output to remote-actuator command input, then remote actuator force output to the link mechanism. This path agrees with the patent's controller signal, actuator output/force member/link, and resulting motion descriptions (710847db3a194a2881ac80cc4b186a68; 760593d32628038e0e43fb27daf7d644).

flow_consistency.rationale: The command interface has out-to-in port directions, identical signal_electrical port types, a matching controller_actuation flow, and is recorded once. The continuation from remote actuator force_out to link_force_in is also directionally/type compatible. Sensor flows remain separated by measured quantity and direct to corresponding controller inputs.

claim_traceability.rationale: The modeled remote actuation is traceable to the disclosed remotely controlled actuator, output member, force member, and link (710847db3a194a2881ac80cc4b186a68); the parameter sensor signals and controller use are supported by the description (a6fe4f8352fe782d941aaa05fcd47fa0; b994f406c65f2a05941bfdcb68dc1136). No new requirement or claim limitation was added in revision 6.

interfaces.rationale: The prior omitted controller-to-remote-actuator interface is now present at /subsystems/6/interfaces/0 and joins the existing controller_command_out and remote_command_in ports through controller_actuation. Endpoint IDs exist, directions and types match, and no reciprocal duplicate is recorded.

textbook_application.rationale: Context/interface modeling distinguishes external controller and actuation entities and makes the exchanged signal path explicit, consistent with the retrieved context-and-interfaces guidance. Patent facts are established by patent passages, not textbook material.

summary: Independent review of immutable SJS revision 6 finds the prior material defect repaired: one correctly directed interface now connects controller_command_out to remote_command_in via controller_actuation; its remote actuator force path continues to the actuation link. The interface is supported by the patent's express signal-line statement and has existing compatible endpoints. Prior concerns about omitted command-path connection and orphaned flow are resolved; no new material issue is identified. No candidate edits were made.
